paragraphs.text: Back at the beginning, at Pentecost when the Holy Spirit fell upon the Church. The Message come on down into Smyrna; there stood Irenaeus, the great saint of God, speaking in tongues, power of God, raising the dead, healing the sick, he was walking in the Light. After him come Columba, the great powerful saint of God. Many of the other great saints packing the Message on down, walking in the Light, the Gospel Light, the same Light that shined on the Day of Pentecost; Christ standing in the midst of His people, and them seven golden candlesticks reflecting His radiance like the sun in the middle of its heat.
